message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: PR Build Check

on:
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: Checkout code
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                  fetch-depth: 0

            - name: Setup Node.js
              uses: actions/setup-node@v4
              with:
                  node-version: '20'
                  cache: 'npm'

            - name: Install dependencies
              run: npm ci

            - name: Build with production configuration
              run: npx nx build --configuration=production
              env:
                  NODE_ENV: production
                  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=12288",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches npm dependencies via setup-node (cache: 'npm'), so adding another dependency cache is contraindicated by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (equivalent cache already exists). A custom timeout is not supported because ci_history shows no completed runs, so there is no representative successful-duration history to set a safe limit, and the heavy 12 GB production build risks false timeouts. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE applies: this is a pull-request workflow where a newer push to the same PR supersedes older runs, and canceling in-progress superseded runs saves duplicate VM work without reducing build/test coverage (the latest run still completes the full build). Concurrency is scoped by workflow + ref so distinct PRs are isolated, and it adds no privileged actions, secrets, deployments, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
